synachrom.translation: 苯乙烯, 二乙烯苯多孔有机载体

synacme.translation: [医]雌雄同熟：雄蕊、柱头同时成熟

synacmy.translation: [医]雌雄同熟：雄蕊、柱头同时成熟

synactic.translation: a. 一起工作的,合作的

synadelphus.translation: [医] 头躯联胎, 单头单躯八肢畸胎

synaeresis.definition:
n the contraction of two vowels into a diphthong
n the separation of liquid from a gel that is caused by contraction (as in cheese making)
synaeresis.translation:
n. 元音溶合, 缩约
[医] [胶体]凝缩[作用], 脱水收缩[作用]

synaesthesia.definition: n a sensation that normally occurs in one sense modality occurs when another modality is stimulated
synaesthesia.translation: n. [生理][心]联觉,牵连感觉, 共同感觉

synaesthesis.translation: n. (艺术作品所产生的)不同冲动的协调, 对立情感的和谐

synaesthetic.definition: a relating to or experiencing synesthesia; involving more than one sense
synaesthetic.translation: a. [生理][心]联觉的,牵连感觉的, 共同感觉的

synaetosis.translation: [医] 联并畸形, 并合畸形

synagog.translation: n. 犹太教堂, 犹太教徒的集会

synagogical.definition: a. Of or pertaining to a synagogue.
synagogical.translation: a. 犹太教的, 犹太会堂的

synagogue.definition: n. (Judaism) the place of worship for a Jewish congregation
synagogue.translation: n. 犹太人集会, 犹太教会堂, 犹太教

synagogues.definition: n. (Judaism) the place of worship for a Jewish congregation
synagogues.translation: n. 犹太教堂( synagogue的复数形式 )

synalepha.definition:
n. A contraction of syllables by suppressing some vowel or
   diphthong at the end of a word, before another vowel or diphthong; as,
   th' army, for the army.

synallagmatic.definition:
a. Imposing reciprocal obligations upon the parties;
   as, a synallagmatic contract.
synallagmatic.translation: a. [律](条约或合同)双务的,对双方具有约束力的

synanceja.translation: [网络] 毒鲉属；玫瑰毒鲉玫块毒鲉

synangia.translation: n. 聚合囊；聚囊粘菌属 (synangium的变形)

synangium.definition:
n. The divided part beyond the pylangium in the aortic
   trunk of the amphibian heart.

synantherous.definition:
a. Having the stamens united by their anthers; as,
   synantherous flowers.

synanthesis.definition:
n. The simultaneous maturity of the anthers and stigmas
   of a blossom.
synanthesis.translation: [医]雌雄同熟：雄蕊、柱头同时成熟

synanthous.definition:
a. Having flowers and leaves which appear at the same
   time; -- said of certain plants.
synanthous.translation: [植]花和叶同时出现的, 两朵或两朵以上的花反常结合的

synanthropic.translation: a. 生态上与人类关联的

synanthrose.definition:
n. A variety of sugar, isomeric with sucrose, found in
   the tubers of the Jerusalem artichoke (Helianthus tuberosus), in the
   dahlia, and other Compositae.

synapomorphies.translation: (synapomorphy 的复数) n.[生]共源性状

synaposematism.translation: 生物防卫拟态的出现或拥有

synapse.definition: n. the junction between two neurons (axon-to-dendrite) or between a neuron and a muscle
synapse.translation:
n. (神经)突触, 神经键
[医] 突触, 神经键

synapses.definition: n. the side by side pairing of homologous maternal and paternal chromosomes at the start of meiosis
synapses.translation: n. <生>（神经元的）突触( synapse的复数形式 ); 染色体结合( synapsis的复数形式 ); 联会; 突触; （神经元的）触处

synapsid.definition: n. extinct reptile having a single pair of lateral temporal openings in the skull

synapsida.definition: n extinct reptiles of the Permian to Jurassic considered ancestral to mammals

synapsing.definition:
-ing form of synapse
n. the junction between two neurons (axon-to-dendrite) or between a neuron and a muscle
synapsing.translation:
(synapse 的现在分词) n. (神经)突触, 神经键
[医] 突触, 神经键

synapsis.definition: n. the side by side pairing of homologous maternal and paternal chromosomes at the start of meiosis
synapsis.translation:
n. 染色体结合, 联会, 突触
[医] 接合, 联会(指染色体), 突触, 神经键

synaptase.definition:
n. A ferment resembling diastase, found in bitter almonds.
   Cf. Amygdalin, and Emulsin.
synaptase.translation:
[化] 苦杏仁酶
[医] 苦杏仁酶

synapte.translation: n. [宗](希腊正教会的) 连祷

synaptic.translation:
a. 突触的, 联合的
[医] [染色体]接合的, 突触的

synapticula.definition:
n. One of numerous calcareous processes which extend
   between, and unite, the adjacent septa of certain corals, especially of
   the fungian corals.

synaptinemal complex.translation: （细胞）接合丝复合物, 联会丝复合物

synaptonemal complex.translation: （细胞）接合丝复合物, 联会丝复合物

synarthrosis.definition:
n. Immovable articulation by close union, as in sutures.
   It sometimes includes symphysial articulations also. See the Note under
   Articulation, n., 1.
synarthrosis.translation:
n. 不动关节
[医] 不动关节

synasol.translation: 甲醇、乙醇、汽油等混合而成的溶剂

synastry.definition:
n. Concurrence of starry position or influence; hence,
   similarity of condition, fortune, etc., as prefigured by astrological
   calculation.
synastry.translation: n. 【占星术】(预测未来的)诞生图分析

synaxis.definition: n. A congregation; also, formerly, the Lord's Supper.
synaxis.translation: n. (初期教会的)敬拜集会,感恩祭
